proof:
Source: the Remark ("equivalent implementation of step 4") of the parent proof of regcomp_exists_smooth_unit_form_approx, applied to g₂ := f. The support inclusion support h ⊆ support g₂ stated in that Remark is kept as a conclusion, and the parent's |·|_E error 2δ is made ≤ κ. Uses the sibling lemma regcomp_covectorEuclideanNorm_seminorm_retract. Implementation note: Continuous.exists_contDiff_approx lives in Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.SmoothApprox, which is not in the import closure of GMT.Ch07.Submission; the implementation must add this import, as the parent's implementation note prescribes. Notation: Λ^n := Covector (Euclid P) n with operator norm ‖·‖ and dist(α, β) = ‖α − β‖; |·|_E := covectorEuclideanNorm; IsTestForm h means ContDiff ℝ ∞ h ∧ HasCompactSupport h.

0. (Norm facts.) By regcomp_covectorEuclideanNorm_seminorm_retract choose c > 0 such that, for all α, β ∈ Λ^n and t ∈ ℝ: (ii) |α + β|_E ≤ |α|_E + |β|_E; (iii) |t•α|_E = |t|·|α|_E (in particular |−α|_E = |α|_E, also covectorEuclideanNorm_neg); (iv) |α|_E ≤ c‖α‖.

1. (Parameter.) Let δ := min(1/2, κ/2). Then 0 < δ ≤ 1/2 (so 1 − δ ≥ 0) and 2δ ≤ κ.

2. (Smooth approximation.) The map F(x) := (1 − δ) • f(x) is continuous (Continuous.const_smul), and the constant function x ↦ δ/c is continuous and positive. Euclid P is a finite-dimensional real normed space, so Continuous.exists_contDiff_approx applies with order (⊤ : ℕ∞); its conclusion ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) h is ContDiff ℝ ∞ h. It gives h : Euclid P → Λ^n with ContDiff ℝ ∞ h, dist(h(x), F(x)) < δ/c for all x, and support h ⊆ support F.

3. (Support.) support F ⊆ support f (support_const_smul_subset: if (1 − δ)•f(x) ≠ 0 then f(x) ≠ 0), so support h ⊆ support f.

4. (Compact support.) tsupport h = closure(support h) ⊆ closure(support f) = tsupport f (closure_mono). tsupport f is compact because f has compact support, and tsupport h is closed (isClosed_tsupport). So tsupport h is compact (IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset), i.e. HasCompactSupport h. With step 2, IsTestForm h.

5. (Closeness to F.) For every x, by (iv) and dist_eq_norm, |h(x) − F(x)|_E ≤ c‖h(x) − F(x)‖ = c·dist(h(x), F(x)) < c·(δ/c) = δ.

6. (Unit bound.) h(x) = (h(x) − F(x)) + (1 − δ) • f(x). So by (ii), (iii), 1 − δ ≥ 0, step 5 and |f(x)|_E ≤ 1: |h(x)|_E ≤ |h(x) − F(x)|_E + (1 − δ)|f(x)|_E < δ + (1 − δ) = 1.

7. (Closeness to f.) h(x) − f(x) = (h(x) − F(x)) + (−(δ • f(x))). By (ii), (iii), δ > 0 and step 5: |h(x) − f(x)|_E ≤ |h(x) − F(x)|_E + δ|f(x)|_E < δ + δ = 2δ ≤ κ.

8. Steps 2–7 give IsTestForm h, support h ⊆ support f, |h(z)|_E ≤ 1 and |h(z) − f(z)|_E ≤ κ for all z. ∎
key_steps: From regcomp_covectorEuclideanNorm_seminorm_retract: |·|_E is a seminorm with |α|_E ≤ c‖α‖.
With δ = min(1/2, κ/2), apply Continuous.exists_contDiff_approx (order ⊤) to (1 − δ)•f with constant precision δ/c: get a C^∞ h with support h ⊆ support f and ‖h − (1 − δ)f‖ < δ/c.
tsupport h ⊆ tsupport f is compact, so IsTestForm h.
|h − (1 − δ)f|_E < δ, hence |h|_E < δ + (1 − δ) = 1 and |h − f|_E < 2δ ≤ κ.
